records.source: Ahh... I see you in the saloon, surrounded by friends. It doesn't seem like you have any favorites... you're popular with everyone!
records.translation: Ahh... nakikita kita sa Saloon, napalilibutan ng mga kaibigan. Mukhang wala kang natatanging paborito... gusto ka ng lahat!

records.source: Ahh... yes. I see you at the beach. There's some kind of event taking place. You walk up to {0} and say something funny... Hmmm... It seems like you two are good friends.
records.translation: Ahh... oo. Nakikita kita sa Dalampasigan. May isang pagtitipong nagaganap. Lumapit ka kay {0} at may nakakatawang sinabi... Hmmm... Mukhang mabuti kayong magkaibigan.

records.source: Ahhh... yes. It's {0}'s birthday.
records.translation: Ahhh... oo. Kaarawan ni {0}.

records.source: He thought everyone forgot, but then you show up with a nice gift. What a good friend.
records.translation: Akala niya'y nakalimot ang lahat, ngunit dumating ka na may dalang magandang regalo. Napakabuti mong kaibigan.

records.source: She thought everyone forgot, but then you show up with a nice gift. What a good friend.
records.translation: Akala niya'y nakalimot ang lahat, ngunit dumating ka na may dalang magandang regalo. Napakabuti mong kaibigan.

records.source: Hmm... I see you laying on a cot... It looks like a hospital. {0} is there to keep you company while you recover. What a nice friend.
records.translation: Hmm... nakikita kitang nakahiga sa isang maliit na kama... Mukhang ospital ang lugar. Naroon si {0} upang samahan ka habang nagpapagaling. Napakabuti niyang kaibigan.

records.source: Ahh... Indeed. I see you in a room, having a conversation with a man.
records.translation: Ahh... talaga nga. Nakikita kita sa isang silid, nakikipag-usap sa isang lalaki.

records.source: Ahh... Indeed. I see you in a room, having a conversation with a lady.
records.translation: Ahh... talaga nga. Nakikita kita sa isang silid, nakikipag-usap sa isang babae.

records.source: ..  Oh! It's {0}. You seem to be close friends.
records.translation: ..  Ay! Si {0} pala. Mukhang malapit kayong magkaibigan.

records.source: Hmm... I see you sitting in a plush chair by the fire... you're surrounded by luxury, yet filled with lonely desperation.
records.translation: Hmm... nakikita kitang nakaupo sa malambot na silya sa tabi ng apoy... napalilibutan ka ng karangyaan, ngunit balot ka ng desperasyong dulot ng kalungkutan.

records.source: ...Oh? It seems you'll be leaving more than a few heartbroken... Are you playing games with those who put their trust in you? Hmm...
records.translation: ...Ay? Mukhang marami kang iiwang wasak ang puso... Pinaglalaruan mo ba ang mga nagtiwala sa iyo? Hmm...

records.source: Now I see you and {0} in a field of grass. You seem happy.
records.translation: Ngayon, nakikita ko kayo ni {0} sa isang damuhan. Mukha kang masaya.
